purpose: Symmetric short-side decision rules for Trader Apprentice. These rules identify short candidates; they do not autonomously place orders.
core_principle: Short the failed repair or confirmed bearish leverage expansion, not the liquidation low.

short_setups.name: POST_CAPITULATION_FAILED_RECLAIM_SHORT
preconditions: Large long-liquidation/deleveraging event has already occurred.
Price remains below broken dVAL / prior-day-low / value boundary.
CVD improves or buyers become aggressive but price response remains weak.
short_setups.trigger: Retest/reclaim attempt into broken value fails; price cannot accept above dVAL or dPOC.
confirmation: Lower high or rejection candle/sequence below dVAL/dPOC.
CVD stops improving or turns down.
OI stays elevated/rises as price weakens, or collapses only after the trap is already confirmed.
Price loses the post-flush local support after failed reclaim.
short_setups.invalidation: Acceptance above dVAL and preferably dPOC with positive price response and improving flow.
confidence_boosters: Large OI rebuild relative to small price bounce.
Large positive CVD change relative to small price bounce.
Repeated failed attempts to reclaim the same broken value level.
Funding remains positive while price cannot recover, suggesting long-side crowding risk.
avoid: Do not enter first short directly into a vertical capitulation candle.
Do not use OI direction alone as proof of shorts.
Do not short if price reclaims/accepts value and Price UP + CVD UP + OI UP confirms recovery.

short_setups.name: BEARISH_LEVERAGE_EXPANSION_SHORT
short_setups.trigger: Confirmed loss of structural support or failed retest from below while the matrix persists.
confirmation: OI continues expanding while price makes lower lows/lower highs.
CVD continues lower or sell aggression remains effective.
No rapid reclaim of the lost level.
short_setups.invalidation: Price reclaims the lost structure and holds while CVD stabilizes/improves and OI no longer expands bearishly.
short_setups.note: This is the cleanest short-side matrix because new leverage is entering a falling market, but OI still does not identify side with certainty.

short_setups.name: BUYER_FAILURE_SHORT
preconditions: CVD UP or flat while price fails to rise or falls.
OI is flat/up or has rebuilt after a flush.
short_setups.trigger: Buyer effort fails at resistance/value boundary and price rolls over.
confirmation: CVD improvement no longer produces positive price response.
OI stays elevated or rises as price weakens.
short_setups.invalidation: Price converts buyer effort into actual structural reclaim and acceptance.

efficiency_metrics.price_response_to_cvd: Compare price bps change with normalized CVD change over the same compatible window. Large CVD improvement with tiny price improvement = buyer inefficiency.
efficiency_metrics.price_response_to_oi: Compare price bps change with OI percentage change. Large OI rebuild with weak price response below value = fragile leverage/crowding.
efficiency_metrics.failed_reclaim_count: Count repeated attempts that trade into/through a broken level but fail to hold above it.
efficiency_metrics.path_requirement: Use local high, local low, rejection, and retest sequence; do not classify from distant endpoints only.
